winner.text: Add one leakage-safe categorical cross field formed as tab×hour to let the FM model assign distinct interaction effects to request surface and time of day.
winner.rationale: Request context was the only feature family with positive, stable train-only temporal screening lift (+0.00221 primary across all four reported days). Official diagnostics show substantial context heterogeneity, including poor ranking for tab 0 and tab 6 and weak hours 3 and 4, so a single explicit context conjunction is a focused remedy without introducing a new data source.
winner.exact_ablation: Add exactly one train-vocabulary categorical FM field, tab_hour, defined by concatenating the existing impression-time tab and derived hour values; retain all seven existing fields, FM dimension, loss, optimizer, seed, and training schedule unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: +0.001 to +0.004 by improving within-user discrimination when tab effects vary by hour.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: +0.002 to +0.006 by correcting context-specific top-five inversions, especially on large weak tabs.

selection_rationale: c01 is the strongest next scarce experiment: it has the top consultant utility score (0.83), the highest confidence among candidates (4), low leakage and runtime risk, and a focused single-field ablation. It directly builds on the only feature family with stable positive train-only temporal screening lift (+0.00221 primary across all four days) and targets substantial, supported tab and hour ranking heterogeneity, including large weak tab 0 and tab 6 slices. Its expected primary gain (+0.003) matches the baseline calibration expectation while being more evidence-grounded and lower-risk than broader architecture replacements.
